ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement contains financial maintenance covenants requiring the Company to maintain (i) a maximum Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio of 2.50 to 1.00, with cash netting of up to $ 100.0 million, and (ii) a minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) of 1.25 to 1.00, tested quarterly.

The Credit Agreement contains financial maintenance covenants requiring the Company to maintain (i) a maximum Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio of 2.50 to 1.00, with cash netting of up to $ 100.0 million, and (ii) a minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) of 1.25 to 1.00, tested quarterly.

parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance with all covenants as of September 30, 2026. Net leverage allows cash netting of up to $100.0 million. No borrowings were outstanding under the $150.0 million revolver. The Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio also sets the pricing grid (interest margin and commitment fee); that rate-setting use was not reported separately.
